content.short: A business accelerator and launchpad for innovative start-ups on Cardano, backed by the Genius Yield team. Initial Stake Pool Offering is now live!
content.description:
Genius X is an Accelerator and Launchpad platform built with the purpose of boosting innovative start-ups and projects on Cardano. Bringing the experience of the team that founded Genius Yield, a Cardano Decentralized Exchange and Yield Optimizer, it is the mission of Genius X to foster innovation and growth that will establish Cardano as the leading blockchain ecosystem.

The accelerator methodology is simple: empower founders to build impactful and scalable blockchain-based companies by assisting with developing a successful business strategy and providing key consulting services and necessary advisory networks, financial infrastructure, and technological expertise to propel our clients in attaining speed, scale, and edge. Many fledgling blockchain based companies operate with lean teams as they are pre-funding and pre-revenue and may not have the required Networks or knowhow to scale their businesses effectively. As a result, they require assistance in any number of Business Development activities.

Genius X provides business Developers assistance with: Business development strategy Fundraising and finance strategies Marketing strategy and execution Graphic design Tokenomics design Team building support Smart contract consulting and audits Initial Stake Pool Offering (ISPO) design Exchange listing Legal and Regulatory support Tax and Audit assistance Crypto-Friendly Bank Introduction Integration into the Genius Yield ecosystem To provide these services Genius X brings a team of professionals who provide business acumen to early stage startups in terms of strategy and execution, access to relevant networks and assist in sourcing funding.

The Genius X Launchpad built along side the Accelerator platform to simplify the funding experience and offer private round funding access to retail investors.

GENSX is a utility token with a maximum supply of 1 billion. The GENSX token can be staked in the Genius X Staking center for extra rewards and to receive various platform benefits.
